# Third-party browser libraries

- Chart.js 4.4.0 — MIT License — https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
- chartjs-plugin-annotation 3.0.1 — MIT License — https://github.com/chartjs/chartjs-plugin-annotation

The vendored minified files are pinned copies used so the local farm dashboard
continues to render when its Internet connection or a public CDN is unavailable.
